name: TechOps pipeline dashboard
summary: The internal dashboard TechOps uses to follow captures through processing: filters, capture timelines, processing times and metrics by company, project and project type. Setting a capture's processing outcome is PROC-REQ-016 and SLA monitoring is PROC-FEAT-05.

roles.note: The dashboard signs in with ordinary Track3D credentials and has no staff check of its own.

actions.action: Set processing time and status for a capture
actions.note: Intended for TechOps only; enforcement unverified

nfr.statement: Time to load the dashboard's default seven-day view.
nfr.open_question: How many captures does a typical seven-day view hold, and what load time does TechOps need?

requirements.title: The TechOps dashboard opens on the last seven days and shows its filters
requirements.statement: The TechOps dashboard shows the last seven days by default, and the filters in use are shown on screen. When nothing matches, it says so.

sources.title: Prior PRDs - TechOps dashboard, 360 image automation and issue emails (t3d-prd-agent prd-organised)

sources.title: Direct code reads during USER migration (2026-10-29)

acceptance_criteria.given: A TechOps user opens the dashboard
acceptance_criteria.then: Captures from the last seven days up to today are shown, and the date filter is visible

acceptance_criteria.given: No captures in the last seven days
acceptance_criteria.then: A message says no data is available

requirements.title: TechOps can set processing times and see a capture's path
requirements.statement: TechOps can set a different processing time for each capture, and see the path a capture took through the pipeline. A capture with no processing time prompts for one.
requirements.rationale: The dashboard has a per-job capture timeline view. Where processing times are stored, and the service behind it, were not found.

requirements.title: Delivery metrics by date, company, project and project type
requirements.statement: Track3D staff can filter onboarding, capture and progress-monitoring metrics by date, company, project and type of project. Several selected projects are aggregated. SLA metrics are PROC-REQ-028.

acceptance_criteria.then: Onboarding, capture and progress-monitoring metrics are shown combined for both projects

requirements.title: Internal users see project notifications in one place
requirements.statement: In the internal project tool, each project has a notifications tab and its project card shows an unread count. Projects can be sorted by their latest notification. Opening the tab marks its notifications read; each event is a separate entry.
requirements.rationale: PRD-only. The internal app it describes was not found in the checkouts read.
